critical_code_review_comments: RupiahInput.handle builds a synthetic event by spreading `e` and overriding target/currentTarget — handlers that read e.target.checked/type or call e.target.focus() would break. Currently all 70 usages only read value, so no defect found, but consider passing the real input element with a normalized value instead.

className splitting via SIZE_RE only moves h-*/text-* to the inner input; any other size-affecting class (e.g. w-[200px], col-span-*) stays on the wrapper div — this worked in all tested cases (P57.previewPrice w-[200px], termValue sm:col-span-2) but is fragile if someone passes e.g. 'px-2' expecting it on the input.
Leading-zero strip uses /^0+(?=\d)/ so a single '0' remains '0' (intentional), but MAX_DIGITS=15 silently truncates paste of longer numbers without user feedback.
